channel.title: ASF Jira
channel.description: This file is an XML representation of an issue

item.title: [PARQUET-1979] Optional bloom_filter_offset is filled if no bloom filter is present
item.description: Currently the field bloom_filter_offset is filled (with the value 0) even if no bloom filter is saved for the related column chunk. This is not correct as this field is optional so we should not fill it in this case.
item.summary: Optional bloom_filter_offset is filled if no bloom filter is present

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.
